text:
Liang (Customer): Hey team, heads up — after the morning deploy our translation endpoint is returning English for a bunch of Simplified Chinese inputs. Customer examples attached.

Liang (Customer): Example: input: "把发票发给我" expected: Chinese response or Chinese->English translation, got: "Please send me the invoice" (English but lower quality).

Liang (Customer): Also another input where we asked for zh-CN -> en translation and got back an English paraphrase with dropped entities. This started at ~2026-03-05 09:12 UTC right after the canary finished.

Maya (CSE): Sorry you're hitting this, Liang — can you paste the exact API call (headers + body) and the request id if available? We'll escalate.

Liang (Customer): Sure, here's anonymized call: 
```
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "open-compat-7b:2026-03-05",
  "input_language": "zh-CN",
  "task": "translate",
  "target_language": "en",
  "prompt": "把发票发给我"
}
```
Request-ID: req_0a9f3b2c

Omar (Support): Thanks. Can confirm we have a handful of similar tickets from APAC customers since the canary completed. Route: /v1/generate, model: open-compat-7b:2026-03-05.

Omar (Support): Quick repro steps I ran: same payload -> English reply but shorter and some entities stripped. Latency normal. No auth/billing errors.

deploy-bot: Canary completed for open-compat-7b:2026-03-05 at 2026-03-05T09:11:47Z :white_check_mark:

Maya (CSE): Assigning to eng runtime + ML. @Nima can you triage model variant? Might be an input-language detection change or tokenizer mismatch.

Nima (ML Eng): On it. First guess: a change in prefix-handling or default language fallback behavior in the new release. Could be that the model no longer honors input_language hint in some routing paths. Request ID helps. I'll fetch logs.

Nima (ML Eng): Fetching logs for req_0a9f3b2c...

Nima (ML Eng): Found the request trace. Routing took path: hosted-us-west -> fallback: open-compat-7b:quantized-v2. The canary introduced a new quantized kernel. Stack shows we applied language-detection heuristic earlier in the runtime patch.

Nima (ML Eng): Log snippet:
```
[09:12:14.123] req_0a9f3b2c received, lang_hint=zh-CN, runtime: kernel-selector v16
[09:12:14.140] kernel-selector chose quantized-v2, kv_cache_mode=prefix-cache-fast
[09:12:14.145] postproc: language_decider called -> predicted_lang=en_conf=0.62
[09:12:14.152] generate started -> output_lang=en
```

Omar (Support): So the runtime is deciding output language based on a weak prediction and overriding explicit input_language? That would explain customer reports.

Nima (ML Eng): Looks like the postproc language_decider now runs after kernel selection and can override target_language when conf > 0.6. That's a new heuristic from the rollout. Previously we respected explicit target_language flags.

Maya (CSE): Is this deterministic? Could explain intermittent customer complaints.

Nima (ML Eng): Repro is consistent for this payload on quantized-v2 paths. For larger prompts results vary.

sre-oncall: Not seeing infra issues. CPU/GPU utilization fine. No error spikes.

Maya (CSE): Proposed immediate mitigation: rollback postproc heuristic in runtime or route affected customers to pre-canary model variant. Customer asks for quick fix.

Nima (ML Eng): I can push a hotfix to skip language_decider when input_language/target_language are provided in the request. That is safe and small. ETA ~30 min.

Omar (Support): Please also surface a temporary workaround to customers: explicitly supply full prompt template e.g., "<translate from=zh-CN to=en> ..." or set header X-Force-Language: en. But we should fix server-side.

Liang (Customer): A workaround header would be great for now. We can apply it client-side but prefer service fix. Thanks.

Nima (ML Eng): I'll open a rollback patch and a config gate. If tested, we'll flip for the affected region first (APAC) then global.

deploy-bot: Rolling config gate to APAC for open-compat-7b:2026-03-05 at 2026-03-05T09:46:01Z :rocket:

Omar (Support): Liang, can you confirm after ~09:47 UTC whether translations look normal?

Liang (Customer): Confirmed — after 09:48 translations are back to expected zh->en results for our sample requests. Thanks for the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:

Maya (CSE): I'll keep this thread open until Nima posts the final PR and we have a postmortem note.

Nima (ML Eng): Filed PR #4578 and a short postmortem draft. Root cause: postproc language_decider heuristic activated post-kernel selection, which could override explicit request language hints for quantized-v2 routing. Fix: prefer explicit input/target language in postproc and add integration tests.

Maya (CSE): Marking as resolved for customer. Internal follow-ups: add regression test using zh-CN samples, review rollout checklist to include language-sensitive regression cases.

Liang (Customer): Appreciate the help and quick response.

sre-oncall: Adding notes to incident tracker: INC-2026-03-05-09-lang-fallbacks

Maya (CSE): Thanks everyone. Closing customer loop and preparing brief status email to the customer. :email:
